tasks.title: Implement inline image magic byte rejection in read_file and prune toolset
steps: Remove imports of imagex and golang.org/x/image from tools/tools.go.
In read_file in tools/tools.go, inspect the initial 16 bytes of the file for magic signatures: PNG (\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n), JPEG (\xff\xd8\xff), GIF (GIF87a or GIF89a), and WebP (RIFF....WEBP).
When an image signature is detected in read_file, return core.ErrResult(\"unsupported_file\", ...) with a detail message indicating reading images is not supported and naming the detected format.
Update read_file tool description and output schema to remove image output descriptions and properties.
Update tools.All to omit registration of fetch_url, powershell, and subagent, keeping only approved workspace mechanics and navigation tools.
Update tools/conformance_test.go to remove tests and references for fetch_url, powershell, and subagent.
Run and pass TS-09-5, TS-09-6, TS-09-7, TS-09-8, and TS-09-9.
